description:
Quote the maximum hold for LightX relight; nothing is charged.

Required video_url is an owned source video (at least 49/24 seconds and at most 15 seconds, up to 100 MB).
relit_cond_type='ic' (default) requires relight_parameters (relight_prompt, bg_source Left/Right/Top/Bottom,
cfg 1-10, use_sky_mask); ref, hdr and bg require owned reference_image_url (or relit_cond_img_url) and
optional ref_id (0-48). Original audio is preserved. Pass cost_rub as max_cost_rub when creating; hold
covers at least 5 seconds or ceil(source seconds), settled to actual invoice later.

ref_id.description: Optional frame index (0-48) for reference conditioning.
ref_id.title: Ref Id

reference_image_url.description: Conditioning image from your own uploads or results for ref, hdr, or bg.
reference_image_url.title: Reference Image Url

relight_parameters.description: Required when relit_cond_type='ic'; forbidden for ref, hdr, and bg.

relit_cond_img_url.description: Alias for reference_image_url; if both are set they must match.
relit_cond_img_url.title: Relit Cond Img Url

video_url.description: Source video from your own uploads or results; at least 49/24 seconds and at most 15 seconds.
video_url.title: Video Url

name: estimate_lightx_relight
